payload.roles: Inherited from se, no new roles: the owner (opens iterations, blesses gates, pushes); the driving agent (walks the machine, builds); the adjudicator (blesses - here the owner, attended); the maintainer (future readers of trunk). Enabled-but-not-staffed by i5b: parallel agents each holding their own worktree.
payload.tensions: The named goal-system conflicts are the live ones: (1) default isolation (every iteration branches, a cost per iteration) vs convenience (skip the overhead for tiny work) - resolved for isolation; off-by-default was the defect. (2) the driving agent's pull to ship fast vs the owner's requirement that it be PROVEN live - resolved for proven; fast-without-proof caused the regression this iteration fixes. No new stakeholder-specific tensions beyond these.
